stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 45%/15%, Mr. Action Jackson 73%/38%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 82% / 50%, The Mahomies 30% / 3.7%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.
🔒 CLINCH WATCH: Gibb it to Me Baby can all but clinch a playoff spot with a win over Kirbo Crushers (99.5% with a win, 93.4% with a loss).
🛡️ SURVIVOR MATH: 1 of 3 still standing, 0.7 expected to survive (likely 0–1).
⚡ Early edge: Mr. Action Jackson went from 39% to 72% against Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy, led by Mumpfield (10.90 pts).
📊 LIVE STANDINGS: As it stands, Ruffing the Passer would climb from 7th into a playoff spot (6th), bumping Mr. Action Jackson to 7th.
🕰️ Coulda-shoulda swap: If Kyle Tucker and Gibb it to Me Baby had swapped Smith-Njigba and Irving for Gibbs and Olave back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🏈 5 matchups are still up for grabs, and Brock You Like a Hurricane vs TDsMaGee (Brock You Like a Hurricane 65%) is the tightest.
🪑 Brock You Like a Hurricane has left 19.50 pts on the bench this week. Starting Blake Corum (29.50 pts) over Emmett Johnson (19.60 pts) alone was worth 9.90 pts.
🎸 DEEP CUTS: TDsMaGee is starting Knight (8%) and Hunter (23%) while Price (74%) and Cousins (71%) sit. % = rostered across ESPN.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
